child_macro: playbook file skills/install-mongo-kit/playbooks/3-unit_migration.md executed by hand (no !mongo_* macros in this install)
expected_cost_note: calibration: 1 unit, ~1 session-hour; sets the loader/harness pattern

batches.brief:
Wave 0 reference data. Load CODES -> codes keyed by (codeType, codeVal). All other units resolve *_cd labels through this collection at read time (facade.py:110-128); the UNKNOWN(<cd>) contract (billing-report-contract.md:28-30) stays in application code. Seed the 14 static rows from 03_seed_static.sql plus synthetic unknown codes.

Repo otterworks, branch tp-run/mongodb-20260922T142645Z (PR target; never tech-partnerships/main). recon_mode offline, stop_mode hard: run every command as `env -u MONGODB_ATLAS_URI ...`; local Docker only (Oracle Free 127.0.0.1:1521 FREEPDB1 fixture built from services/legacy-billing/db/oracle/{schema,packages}/*.sql minus 04_upgrade_static.sql (D-010), MongoDB mongo:7 127.0.0.1:27017, target db ow_billing_offline only). Legacy tree services/legacy-billing/ is read-only. Contract: .migration/02_tolerances.json (tol-1), mapping .migration/03_mapping_spec.json (map-draft-2, regenerate only via model_patch.py + 05_decisions.json), census .migration/census.json. Fixture: synthetic seed under migration/mongo/fixtures/ that exercises every census trap for this unit's tables (string dates incl. unparseable, Y/N flags incl. NULL, CSV lists incl. malformed, repeating groups, orphans/unenforced pointers, sequence ids, empty strings, CHAR padding); write .migration/fixtures/<batch>.json {source,method,masked_columns,produced_at,produced_by,row_counts}. Loader: migration/mongo/loaders/<unit>.py, spec-driven from 03_mapping_spec.json, idempotent (upsert by key; rerun yields zero diff). Verify: harness `recon run --mode fixture` (venv /home/ubuntu/mmp-venv) PASS, then one fault injection (delete/alter one target doc or field) proving FAIL, then rerun loader and PASS again; evidence redacted under .migration/recon/<unit>/ incl. recon.summary.md. `make tp-smoke` before the PR. One held PR per unit into the tp-run branch: sections Decisions / Code / Evidence, unverified paths first, recon.summary.md rendered, `merge_eligible: false` stated. Do not merge. Cap 3 recon reruns; same-class failure x3 across units halts the wave.
